svg.title: Karameh, Dawson’s Field, Black September and PLO Relocation to Lebanon (1968–72)
svg.desc: High-precision 1:10m GIS historical atlas map of post-June 1967 Jordan, Israel, the Israeli-occupied West Bank, Golan Heights, Gaza, and Sinai, Syria, and Lebanon, showing the Battle of Karameh (March 1968), Dawson’s Field hijackings (September 1970), Black September fighting in Amman, the repelled Syrian tank incursion at Ramtha/Irbid, and PLO relocation via Syria to Southern Lebanon and Beirut.

text.tspan: Held by Israel After Six-Day War

Driven from Jordan via Syria to Lebanon
